messages.text:
"3D first-person psychological horror game with a narrative-driven, retro-surrealist art style. Story: You play as Elias, a \"Memory Curator\" tasked with archiving the final hours of a dead city where time moves backward. As you explore the shifting architecture, audio logs and environmental storytelling reveal that Elias is actually dead, trapped inside his own dying brain as it attempts to process a fatal car crash; every room represents a fragmented memory he is trying to rewrite to escape his guilt. Core mechanic: gravity shifts based on blinking, and objects permanently leave glowing sonic footprints of past actions. An invisible entity—representing his repressed trauma—hunts him by consuming these historical echoes. Win condition: reach the central archive and erase your own footprints to finally accept the truth and let go. Minimalist UI, zero combat, pure narrative dread and atmospheric horror.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
